lines.text: Jesus says nothing hidden will stay unknown, and what He tells them in the dark they must speak in daylight.
Jesus says not to fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul.
Two sparrows are sold for a talent, yet none falls apart from the Father's will, and disciples are worth more.
Jesus came to bring a sword, and whoever does not take up his staff and follow Him is unworthy.
A cup of cold water given to a little one because he is Jesus' disciple earns reward; Jesus then teaches.
